description: This walk takes you along Lough Rea in the town of Loughrea in County Galway. You can start your walk at the Long Point car park on the eastern side of the lake. Here you can pick up a lovely lakeside path with some excellent views over the water. You can continue your walking in the area on the Gort River Walk or the Ballinasloe Forest Walk - Woodlawn Woods Walk.
